job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes platform
job.location: SF, NYC, Seattle, D.C., Denver, Austin, Atlanta
job.pay_full: Estimated annual salary by hiring location: San Francisco $194,000 – $266,000; New York City, Seattle and Washington D.C. $185,000 – $254,000; Denver $168,000 – $231,000. Eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan.

details.about: Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks, protecting and speeding up millions of websites and internet properties. Many of its critical internal services, including its control plane and APIs, data analytics and the tools that manage its global network, run on Kubernetes platforms it built from the ground up on bare-metal Linux in regions around the world, at the scale of tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of traffic. The Kubernetes platform team builds the tools engineers use to deploy and operate those services; the role mixes software engineering with DevOps operations.
duties: Design scalable, resilient systems that keep up with company growth
Help application teams architect their systems to run well on Kubernetes
Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours and accidents
Improve efficiency of CPU, memory, bandwidth and storage use
Help respond to, resolve and prevent incidents
Contribute to open source projects such as Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, Calico, Ceph, Rook and KubeVirt
needs: Experience operating on-premise systems at scale (SRE, systems design or architecture)
Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside Linux (isolation, storage, networking)
A firm grasp of IP networking, including routing and iptables/nftables
Ability to work in Go, TypeScript and Bash/shell
Ability to break down complex problems, weigh trade-offs and build consensus
nice: Running etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy or Contour
Using Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis or Consul
details.benefits: Estimated annual salary: San Francisco $194,000 – $266,000; New York City, Seattle and Washington D.C. $185,000 – $254,000; Denver $168,000 – $231,000 (may be adjusted by work location). Eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan. US benefits include medical/Rx, dental and vision insurance, flexible and commuter spending accounts, fertility and family-forming benefits, mental health support and an employee assistance program, global travel medical insurance, short and long term disability, life and accident insurance, a 401(k) plan, an employee stock participation plan, flexible paid time off, and parental, pregnancy health, medical and bereavement leave.
notes: Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026
Candidates who reach the offer stage may be asked to attend an in-person interview at a Cloudflare office or hub
May require access to technology controlled under U.S. export laws
